querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_compcode,
                                      report_type,
                                      statement_type,
                                      begindate,
                                      enddate,
                                      eps_basic,
                                      eps_diluted,
                                      bps,
                                      grps,
                                      cash_flows_opera_activ_per,
                                      net_profit_rate,
                                      grossprofitmargin,
                                      opprofit_rate,
                                      profit_bef_tax_rate,
                                      roe,
                                      roa,
                                      roic,
                                      effe_income_tax_rate,
                                      ocftoor,
                                      debttoequity,
                                      assetstoequity,
                                      debttoassets,
                                      tot_liab_investcapital,
                                      parsh_int_investcapital,
                                      quick_ratio,
                                      current_ratio,
                                      cashtoliqdebt,
                                      non_cur_assets_to_equity,
                                      ffo_to_tot_liab,
                                      ffo_to_tot_cur_liab,
                                      invturn,
                                      caturn,
                                      faturn,
                                      assetsturn,
                                      input_costs,
                                      crncy_code,
                                      ann_dt,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_hkfinancialindicator.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.hkfinancialindicator WHERE enddate BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
